name: CorrelationIdFilter
description: Filter for adding correlation IDs to track requests across microservices

fields.name: correlationIdHeaderName
fields.description: Name of the header for correlation ID

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns a filter that adds correlation ID to requests

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of this filter in the filter chain

methods.name: generateCorrelationId
methods.description: Generates a unique correlation ID for tracking

methods.name: addCorrelationId
methods.description: Adds correlation ID to the request and response headers

name: CircuitBreakerConfig
description: Configuration for circuit breaker patterns to handle service failures

fields.name: defaultFailureRateThreshold
fields.description: Threshold percentage for failure rate to trip circuit breaker

fields.name: slowCallRateThreshold
fields.description: Threshold percentage for slow call rate to trip circuit breaker

fields.name: slowCallDurationThreshold
fields.description: Duration threshold to consider a call as slow

fields.name: permittedNumberOfCallsInHalfOpenState
fields.description: Number of calls allowed in half-open state

fields.name: slidingWindowSize
fields.description: Size of the sliding window for call statistics

fields.name: minimumNumberOfCalls
fields.description: Minimum number of calls required before calculations

fields.name: waitDurationInOpenState
fields.description: Duration to wait before transitioning from open to half-open

methods.name: defaultCircuitBreakerFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures a circuit breaker factory with default settings

methods.name: timeLimiterConfig
methods.description: Configures time limiters for circuit breakers
